claims.text: Royal Order A/160 dated 10/7/1436 AH: on the nomination of Crown Prince Mohammed bin Nayef in a letter of the same date, and after the support of the great majority of Allegiance Commission members, King Salman selects Prince Mohammed bin Salman bin Abdulaziz as Deputy Crown Prince and appoints him Second Deputy Prime Minister, Minister of Defence and Chairman of the Council of Economic and Development Affairs. The preamble cites item Third of Royal Order A/135 and item Fourth of Royal Order A/86.
claims.locator: Order number and date; recitals; item First; trailer (filed 06:16 Makkah time)
claims.uncertainty: 'Great majority' is unquantified. Deputy Crown Prince is a separate office and is not a role in this packet; no holder is added.

scope_note: First addition to the 29 April 2015 royal-orders release. It carries no dateline of its own; the portal timestamp is 06:18 Makkah time on 29 April 2015. Used for SA-EXEC-06.
